entries.name: ci10-fast-path-accepts-non-docs
entries.claim: Only an added or edited Markdown document qualifies a pull request for the docs fast path; any other file or a deletion sends it down the normal quick path.

test.namePattern: CI-10: only a docs-only pull request takes the docs fast path

kills.name: CI-10: only a docs-only pull request takes the docs fast path

entries.name: ci10-main-push-takes-fast-path
entries.claim: A main push never takes the docs fast path, so main still runs every fixed suite over each docs change.

test.namePattern: CI-10: only a docs-only pull request takes the docs fast path

kills.name: CI-10: only a docs-only pull request takes the docs fast path
kills.expected: a main push never takes the docs fast path

entries.name: ci10-unlisted-document-reader
entries.claim: A unit or compiler test that reads a Markdown document must be listed in documentReaders, or a docs-only pull request would skip it.

test.namePattern: CI-10: every unit or compiler reader of a Markdown document is in documentReaders

kills.name: CI-10: every unit or compiler reader of a Markdown document is in documentReaders

entries.name: ci10-docs-run-keeps-unit-suite
entries.claim: A docs-only quick run keeps architecture as its only fixed suite and runs document readers by name.

test.namePattern: CI-10: a docs-only quick run keeps architecture whole and runs the document readers by name

kills.name: CI-10: a docs-only quick run keeps architecture whole and runs the document readers by name
kills.expected: a docs-only run keeps architecture as its only fixed suite

entries.name: ci10-unit-step-ungated
entries.claim: The docs flag gates the unit suite step, so a docs-only pull request skips it.
entries.original:
- name: Run unit tests
        if: needs.select.outputs.docs != 'true'

test.namePattern: CI-10: the docs flag skips only the steps a Markdown change cannot affect

kills.name: CI-10: the docs flag skips only the steps a Markdown change cannot affect
